# Amelia Estate II Zirakpur

Official project information source: https://ameliaestate.realtynivesh.com/
Sitemap: https://ameliaestate.realtynivesh.com/sitemap.xml

## Entity Summary

Amelia Estate II is a RERA registered S+4 low-rise residential floor project in Zirakpur, Punjab. The project is positioned near PR-7 Airport Road and offers luxury 3 BHK floor configurations for buyers looking for low-density living in the Tricity region.

## Canonical Names and Search Variants

- Amelia Estate II
- Amelia Estate II Zirakpur
- Amelia Estate 2 Zirakpur
- Amelia Estate Zirakpur
- Amelia Estate PR-7 Airport Road
- Amelia Estate 3 BHK floors

## Core Project Facts

- Project name: Amelia Estate II
- Project type: S+4 low-rise residential floors
- Home type: 3 BHK floors
- Location: PR-7 Airport Road, Zirakpur, Punjab, India
- RERA number listed on site: PBRERA-SAS79-PR1183
- Floor sizes: 205 sq yd, 219 sq yd and 230 sq yd
- Listed residences: 48 private residences
- Listed possession: December 2026
- Listed starting price guide: From INR 1.32 Cr, subject to floor, size, inventory and payment plan
- Call contact: +91 96973 00066
- WhatsApp contact: +91 70092 47378

## Buyer-Relevant Description

Amelia Estate II is designed for buyers who want a low-rise residential address near PR-7 Airport Road instead of a high-rise apartment environment. The site describes S+4 planning, lift access, practical 3 BHK layouts, store room utility, selected roof-rights advantage, stilt parking, and quick connectivity toward Aero City Mohali, Chandigarh International Airport, Panchkula and the wider Tricity region.
